Servers: VPN Gate Academic Experiment (University of Tsukuba, Japan) — free volunteer servers.

VPN Memo Pro is a free VPN client. It connects you with an encrypted OpenVPN tunnel to free public servers run by volunteers of the VPN Gate Academic Experiment at the University of Tsukuba, Japan.

What the app does:
• Downloads the public VPN Gate server list and checks which servers answer, so you only see working servers.
• Creates an encrypted OpenVPN tunnel (VpnService) between your phone and the server you choose. All your internet traffic then goes through that server.

Your privacy:
• The app has no account, no ads and no analytics. It does not collect, store, sell or share your browsing data or any personal data.
• Your settings stay on your phone only.
• Important: the servers are run by independent volunteers, not by us. According to the VPN Gate policy, server operators keep connection logs (such as your IP address and connection time) for a limited period. Do not use the service for anything illegal, and do not rely on it for strong anonymity.

Open source:
This app is based on "OpenVPN for Android" by Arne Schwabe and OpenVPN, licensed under the GNU GPL v2. The full source code is available at:
https://github.com/memo32milano-ops/vpn-memo
